name: compress-threshold-fix
goal: Fix compress + auto-compaction failures on Copilot models by lowering context thresholds in dcp.jsonc and rewriting the context-limit-nudge prompt to prefer multiple smaller compressions

subtasks.name: update-dcp-thresholds
subtasks.description: Update dcp.jsonc thresholds: maxContextLimit 60%→45%, minContextLimit 20%→15%, nudgeFrequency 5→3, iterationNudgeThreshold 8→5

subtasks.name: rewrite-nudge-and-verification
subtasks.description: Rewrite context-limit-nudge.md to prefer multiple small compressions; write verification protocol to inbox
